prompt:
Loop 057 — bounded MEDIUM tests/docs-only evidence-acquisition planning batch.

Goal:
Turn the accepted Loop 056 static-to-live gap audit into a machine-checkable plan that distinguishes what work may be prepared safely now from what evidence cannot be resolved without a separately authorized external/live step. This task MUST NOT gather external evidence, contact providers, choose a trust source, change permissions, or authorize any live action.

Read first:
- docs/JULES_TASK_PROMPT_SPEC.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_TO_LIVE_GAP_AUDIT.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_BLOCKERS.md
- docs/RELAY_PROVENANCE_TRUST_SOURCE_DECISION_SUPPORT.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md

Allowed changed paths only:
- tests/relay/test_live_evidence_acquisition_plan.py
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_ACQUISITION_PLAN.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md

Hard scope / Do Not Touch:
- tests/docs/checkpoint only
- no src/ production changes
- no schemas
- no workflows or workflow permissions
- no dependency/lockfile changes
- no GitHub API/client implementation
- no OIDC token request
- no attestation generation/verification
- no provider/model/API/auth/credential/billing/settings operation
- no network/socket/HTTP
- no live probe
- no Merge
- no rebase / merge commit / force push / conflict auto-resolution
- retry=0
- fallback=disabled
- if a correct solution needs an out-of-scope file, STOP and report instead

Reuse-first:
- Parse/reuse the accepted 30-row gap inventory in docs/RELAY_STATIC_TO_LIVE_GAP_AUDIT.md.
- Do not recreate provider blocker semantics from memory.
- Do not add new provider facts not already present in checked-in canonical docs.
- Do not convert a planning classification into evidence that a blocker is resolved.

Required semantics:
1. Add docs/RELAY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_ACQUISITION_PLAN.md with one plan row for every gap_id from RELAY_STATIC_TO_LIVE_GAP_AUDIT.md.
2. Preserve exactly the same 30 gap_id values. No missing or extra rows.
3. Every row must include:
   - gap_id
   - current_gap_class
   - evidence_stage
   - safe_now_action
   - external_or_live_boundary
   - completion_evidence_required
   - result_state_if_not_proven
4. evidence_stage enum:
   - STATIC_PREPARATION_ONLY
   - READ_ONLY_EVIDENCE_CANDIDATE
   - REQUIRES_BOUNDED_LIVE_PROOF
   - HUMAN_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION
   - FINAL_HUMAN_APPROVAL
   - DEFERRED_NOT_SELECTED
5. The plan is advisory/work-queue classification only. It does NOT authorize an action.
6. Every row must fail closed conceptually: if the required proof is absent/unverifiable, result_state_if_not_proven must remain UNKNOWN/BLOCKED/DEFERRED/NOT_AUTHORIZED as appropriate and never READY/LIVE/AUTHORIZED.
7. Common/provider evidence rows may be classified as STATIC_PREPARATION_ONLY, READ_ONLY_EVIDENCE_CANDIDATE, or REQUIRES_BOUNDED_LIVE_PROOF, but only when that classification is supportable from checked-in docs. If uncertain, use the more conservative stage.
8. Do not state that read-only/static work can fully resolve a blocker unless the canonical source explicitly says so. In particular, runtime retry/replay, executed-model identity, cancellation/restart behavior, quota/billing stop-before-send, or single-request proof must not be treated as resolved by static inspection alone.
9. Provenance rows:
   - KEEP_NOT_WIRED row -> HUMAN_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION with safe default preserved
   - Actions readback row -> HUMAN_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION; transport evidence only, insufficient authenticator
   - OIDC row -> HUMAN_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION; NOT_AUTHORIZED
   - Artifact Attestation row -> HUMAN_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION; NOT_AUTHORIZED
   Do not select a winner.
10. Gemini CLI row -> DEFERRED_NOT_SELECTED; no automatic fallback.
11. first_live_turn row -> FINAL_HUMAN_APPROVAL; no task in this plan may satisfy it automatically.
12. Add a concise "safe work queue" section containing only categories, not a recommendation ranking:
   - static preparation/audits
   - separately authorized read-only evidence gathering
   - bounded live proof requiring explicit authorization
   - human architecture decision
   - final human approval
13. Explicitly state:
   - this file performs zero evidence acquisition;
   - no provider/network/GitHub readback is performed by this batch;
   - no real live blocker is resolved;
   - no provenance is verified;
   - no execution is authorized.
14. Update RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md with PREPARED/static evidence-acquisition-plan status only.

Negative / tamper / failure cases:
- tests must parse the Loop 056 gap table and the new plan table and assert exact identical gap_id sets
- tests must assert every plan row uses one allowed evidence_stage
- tests must verify no row uses READY, LIVE, AUTHORIZED, VERIFIED, PASS, RESOLVED as result_state_if_not_proven
- tests must directly assert runtime-behavior-sensitive gaps are not classified as STATIC_PREPARATION_ONLY when static evidence cannot prove them
- tests must assert the four provenance rows all remain HUMAN_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION and OIDC/Attestation remain NOT_AUTHORIZED
- tests must assert Actions readback remains transport evidence only / insufficient authenticator
- tests must assert Gemini CLI stays DEFERRED_NOT_SELECTED
- tests must assert first_live_turn stays FINAL_HUMAN_APPROVAL
- tests must verify every row has non-empty safe_now_action, boundary, completion evidence, and fail-closed state
- tests must assert docs/checkpoint say zero evidence was acquired and no real blocker resolved
- no vacuous tests: no pass, assertTrue(True), or unrelated string-only placeholders

Acceptance criteria:
- exact allowed-path fence
- exact 30 gap_ids preserved
- every row classified conservatively and machine-checkably
- no action authorization or blocker-resolution claim
- no new provider facts invented
- all important boundary classes directly asserted in tests
- pre-existing green tests alone are not acceptance

Exact validation commands:
Run focused tests first as useful, then exactly once:
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
python -m compileall -q src tests
git diff --check

Publication condition:
Publish the normal isolated Jules PR only if the exact path fence holds, all required semantic assertions are present, full validation is green, and no hard prohibition was crossed. Do not Merge.

Explicit stop conditions:
- stop if the source gap audit cannot be parsed unambiguously
- stop if a classification would require new external/provider facts
- stop if an out-of-scope file is required
- stop if permission/auth/billing/live/trust-source decisions are needed
- stop instead of guessing when checked-in evidence does not justify a less-conservative classification
